Rebuild the source-reconstruction interface from scratch while preserving gameplay, IDs/contracts needed by JS, and the working event-driven mobile input behavior. Use charcoal, dirty olive, bone/cream text, restrained amber/red warnings, utilitarian stencil/condensed typography, thin instrument rules, physical labeling, and quiet military telemetry. NO cyan-neon identity, NO generic glass cards, NO clipped cyberpunk panels, NO app-dashboard look. Redesign start/redeploy screen, top combat telemetry, health, ammo/weapon readout, crosshair, damage feedback, and touch-control appearance as one coherent system. Mobile landscape is first-class and controls must remain reachable and unobstructed. Prefer replacing the existing CSS wholesale and adjust main.js/mobile-source-bridge markup only where necessary. Keep effects cheap for a Three.js game. Return a substantial coherent unified diff within the allowlist, not merely advisory notes. Do not claim tests were run.
